name: Weekly Pool Service
description: Routine cleaning, water testing, baskets, and equipment observations, with specialty tasks clearly scoped.
alt: Backyard swimming pool and patio

name: Pool Acid Washing
description: Assess persistent surface staining, finish suitability, treatment options, and professionally planned water handling.
alt: Finished backyard pool and raised spa

name: Pool Tile Calcium Removal
description: Assess waterline deposits and choose an appropriate cleaning method for sound tile, grout, and nearby finishes.
alt: Pool waterline tile before and after cleaning

name: Pool Leak Detection & Repair
description: Investigate changing water levels, wet areas, fittings, equipment, and suspected concealed plumbing leaks.
alt: Listening equipment used during a pool assessment

name: Pool Pump Repair
description: Diagnose leaks, unusual noise, starting problems, loss of prime, and weak circulation before choosing repair or replacement.
alt: Pool circulation pump and connected pipework

name: Pool Filter Repair
description: Assess leaking housings, damaged elements, valve faults, returning dirt, and unusual pressure trends.
alt: Pool filter vessels and connected circulation plumbing

name: Pool Heater Repair
description: Investigate no-heat symptoms, error codes, shutdowns, and problems affecting only pool or spa mode.
alt: Pool heater installed beside circulation pipework

name: Pool Automation & Smart Controls
description: Coordinate compatible pumps, heaters, lighting, valves, and schedules with clear programming and owner handoff.
alt: Poolside user viewing a phone beside the water

name: Saltwater Pool Conversion
description: Plan chlorine-generator capacity, compatibility, installation, startup, and the care a salt system still needs.
alt: Salt chlorine generator component beside a pool

name: Pool Remodeling
description: Coordinate finish, tile, coping, equipment, and desired backyard changes around the pool’s actual condition.
alt: Backyard pool seen from above

name: Pool Pre-Purchase Inspection
description: Review visible condition and agreed operating checks, with documented observations, limitations, and next steps.
alt: Pool inspection using listening equipment beside the water

name: Pool Equipment Repair
description: Start with the symptom, then assess pumps, filters, controls, valves, and other installed equipment.
alt: Technician assessing pool equipment

name: Pool Heating & Cooling
description: Compare repair and comfort-system options around the pool, equipment, temperature goals, and installation.
alt: Pool heater at an outdoor equipment installation

name: Pool Deck & Coping Joint Repair
description: Assess deteriorated mastic, gaps, separation, and adjacent surfaces before planning joint preparation and repair.
alt: Damaged pool edge and adjoining surface near the deck

name: Pool Equipment Warranty Service
description: Clarify records, eligibility, approval, and the required service process before arranging warranty work.
alt: Installed pool equipment with model labels for service review

name: Pool Plumbing Repair
description: Identify pipe leaks, damaged fittings, faulty valves, restricted flow, and access or restoration needs.
alt: Pool plumbing connections and valves at an equipment pad

name: Pool Electrical Repair
description: Arrange qualified assessment of tripping protection, failed lighting, equipment power, and control-wiring concerns.
alt: Pool equipment electrical controls at an outdoor installation

name: Pool Resurfacing
description: Compare finish condition, preparation, materials, related repairs, water handling, and startup care.
alt: Finished pool and raised spa with surrounding deck

name: Pool Tile Replacement
description: Assess loose, missing, cracked, or outdated tile and plan appropriate materials, preparation, and related work.
alt: Finished pool and spa with waterline tile

name: Pool Chiller & Cooling Systems
description: Review cooling goals, equipment suitability, installation conditions, control integration, and performance concerns.
alt: Pool cooling equipment installed near a backyard pool

name: Pool Removal & Backyard Restoration
description: Plan removal methods, approvals, utilities, debris handling, fill, grading, and the finished yard scope.
alt: Excavator working at a backyard pool demolition site
